## Google Business Profile

**Description** — ✓ 671/750 u16 (671 cp) · headroom 79 · limit: 750, ~250 shown before "more"; no URLs, no promotions, no misspellings — BrightLocal

```
Biggy Smallz Spitmasters is a spitbraai and personal chef catering business run by Martin "Biggy" Mhlongo, cooking since 2017. From a whole spitbraai over the fire to a plated 7-course tasting menu, Biggy and his team bring it to wherever your table is: weddings, milestone birthdays, family celebrations, corporate and construction-site functions, festivals and large gatherings. Based in Mbombela (Nelspruit) in the Mpumalanga Lowveld, and travelling across South Africa and into Mozambique. Biggy has cooked on Ultimate Braai Master, Come Dine With Me SA and Rate My Plate, and has been the South African pitmaster at the Mozambique Barbecue Festival. Get in my belly.
```
